architecture.mechanism: Hybrid solar-wind generation with RBFNN-based predictive controller and deep learning disturbance detector that dynamically adjusts power converter setpoints and stores excess in MOF-based supercapacitor buffer.
architecture.intervention: Install solar panels and micro wind turbines on vehicle roof, connect to a bidirectional DC-DC converter governed by an embedded RBFNN controller trained on real-time irradiance, wind speed, and load forecasts; add a MOF-derived supercapacitor module for short-term buffering; implement a hybrid deep learning monitor to detect and mitigate power quality disturbances.
architecture.expected_effect: Increase usable renewable energy capture by ~30% and extend electric range by ~15% compared to baseline hybrid without intelligent control.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct a controlled track test comparing vehicle range with and without the RBFNN controller under identical solar/wind conditions; if range improvement is not statistically significant (>5% p<0.05), the hypothesis is falsified.
